direction.camera: Guide attention with lens anatomy; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: use concentric framing to move attention between whole and detail; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with concentric focus; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with scientific elegance.
direction.lighting: controlled lens flare; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: optical glass and blackened metal; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around slow focus; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use lens anatomy,concentric focus,optical refraction,crisp edge,slow focus,scientific elegance as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
